description:
INTENT TO SOLE SOURCE
GENERAL INFORMATION
This notice follows the Federal Acquisition Regulation Deviations outlined in the Federal Acquisition
Regulation Overhaul as required by Executive Order (E.O.) 14275, Restoring Common Sense to Federal
Procurement signed April 15, 2025.

The Government plans to issue a sole-source, firm-fixed-price contract in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR) 6.103 and Veterans Affairs Acquisition Regulation (VAAR) 819.7008 Sole Source Awards to Verified SDVOSBs, which authorizes direct contracting with SDVOSBs. The contract is to install reverse osmosis deionization water system at Dublin VA Medical Center. The designated source is Semper Tek Inc. 2200 N. Patterson St.  Valdosta, GA  31602.

In accordance with FAR Part 6, contracts awarded using this authority must be supported by a written justification, and approval will be posted within fourteen (14) days after contract award if the dollar amount meets the threshold. The Government will review all capability statements received by the closing date of this synopsis. The decision not to compete based on responses is solely at the Government's discretion. The information received will be used only to determine whether to pursue a competitive procurement. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this work is 236220   COMMERCIAL AND INSTITUTIONAL BUILDING CONSTRUCTION" size standard of $45 Million.
 
THIS NOTICE OF INTENT IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE QUOTATIONS or
PROPOSALS. No contract award will be made based on quotations or proposals received in response to this notice. No solicitation document exists, and no telephone or email inquiries will be accepted. Any responsible source that believes it can meet the requirement may submit a capability statement to sherri.mitchell@va.gov  no later than May 7, 2026, at 9:00 AM Central Daylight Time (CDT). Please ensure that notice # is cited on all submitted documents to ensure they are properly processed. Disclaimer and Important Notes: Do not include proprietary, classified, confidential, or sensitive information in responses to this notice. This notice does not obligate the Government to award a contract. The Government will not pay for information provided in response to this notice. The Government reserves the right to use the information respondents provide for market research purposes. The Government is under no obligation to acknowledge receipt of or respond to any information submitted
